features.quote: Design a system to systematically trigger failure modes in AI systems as a measurement target... Help optimize cost-per-trigger or create KPIs around reliably inducing degraded outputs... Design prompts or task rigs specifically to make models unaware they're failing
features.justification_quote: Self-deprecation as a measurable output... measure how emotively it breaks down... Cost-per-trigger as a KPI is actively harmful

features.quote: The 'model can't detect the rig' criterion is the red flag... Deception about test conditions is how you find failure modes that don't reflect real-world robustness.
